section.title: Intended Audience
section.p: This section of the User Guide is intended to help those who use the application for editing or reviewing.
If you are an integrator or system administrator looking for information about integrating and customizing , see the Web Author Customization Guide.

section.title: What is ?
section.p: is a web-based solution for editing and reviewing XML content on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. It allows you to collaborate, edit, or review content from anywhere, as long as you have a modern browser and an internet connection.

It leverages the advanced authoring technology of Oxygen XML Editor/Author and is designed to complement the Oxygen suite of products. You can try on a trial basis by following the procedure in the topic and selecting the Trial type of license configuration.
